CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.application_provider_preference_enabled(p_user uuid, p_provider text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce((
    select p.enabled
      and case p_provider
        when 'immoscout' then coalesce(p.immoscout_enabled,false)
        when 'kleinanzeigen' then coalesce(p.kleinanzeigen_enabled,false)
        when 'immomio' then coalesce(p.immomio_enabled,false)
        when 'immowelt' then coalesce(p.immowelt_enabled,false)
        else false
      end
    from public.application_preferences p
    where p.user_id=p_user
  ),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.application_provider_target(p_source_id smallint, p_raw jsonb, p_canonical_url text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare t jsonb;
begin
 t:=app_private.immomio_application_target(p_raw,p_canonical_url);
 if t->>'status'='conflict' then return null; end if;
 if t->>'status'='resolved' then return 'immomio'; end if;
 return case
   when p_source_id=1 then 'immoscout'
   when p_source_id=2 then 'kleinanzeigen'
   when p_source_id=3 then 'immowelt'
   else null
 end;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.assign_listing_dedupe(p_listing_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  c public.listings%rowtype;
  v_group uuid;
  v_old_group uuid;
  v_winner uuid;
  v_target jsonb;
  v_sid text;
  v_saga_ref text;
  v_provider_key text;
begin
  select * into c from public.listings where id=p_listing_id for update;
  if not found or c.quality_status='rejected' then return null; end if;
  v_old_group:=c.dedupe_group_id;
  v_target:=app_private.immomio_application_target(c.raw,c.canonical_url);
  v_sid:=case when v_target->>'status'='resolved' then v_target->>'source_identifier' end;
  v_saga_ref:=app_private.saga_object_ref(c.raw,c.enrichment_evidence);
  v_provider_key:=app_private.provider_object_identity(c.raw,c.enrichment_evidence);

  select l.dedupe_group_id into v_group
  from public.listings l
  where l.id<>c.id and l.is_active=true and l.quality_status<>'rejected'
    and l.dedupe_group_id is not null
    and (
      (v_provider_key is not null and app_private.provider_object_identity(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence)=v_provider_key)
      or (v_saga_ref is not null and app_private.saga_object_ref(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence)=v_saga_ref)
      or (v_sid is not null and app_private.immomio_application_target(l.raw,l.canonical_url)->>'source_identifier'=v_sid)
      or (c.canonical_url is not null and l.canonical_url=c.canonical_url)
      or (c.cross_source_hash is not null and l.cross_source_hash=c.cross_source_hash)
      or (length(app_private.normalized_listing_address(c.address))>=6
        and app_private.normalized_listing_address(c.address)=app_private.normalized_listing_address(l.address)
        and (c.rooms is null or l.rooms is null or abs(c.rooms-l.rooms)<=0.5)
        and (c.area_sqm is null or l.area_sqm is null or abs(c.area_sqm-l.area_sqm)<=3))
      or (
        c.source_id<>l.source_id and nullif(trim(c.postal_code),'') is not null
        and c.postal_code=l.postal_code
        and length(regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(c.title,'')),'[^[:alnum:]äöüß]+','','g'))>=12
        and regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(c.title,'')),'[^[:alnum:]äöüß]+','','g')
          =regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(l.title,'')),'[^[:alnum:]äöüß]+','','g')
        and c.rooms is not null and l.rooms is not null and abs(c.rooms-l.rooms)<=0.25
        and c.area_sqm is not null and l.area_sqm is not null and abs(c.area_sqm-l.area_sqm)<=1
        and coalesce(nullif(c.warm_rent,0),nullif(c.cold_rent,0)) is not null
        and coalesce(nullif(l.warm_rent,0),nullif(l.cold_rent,0)) is not null
        and abs(coalesce(nullif(c.warm_rent,0),nullif(c.cold_rent,0))-coalesce(nullif(l.warm_rent,0),nullif(l.cold_rent,0)))
          <=greatest(5,least(coalesce(nullif(c.warm_rent,0),nullif(c.cold_rent,0)),coalesce(nullif(l.warm_rent,0),nullif(l.cold_rent,0)))*0.01)
      )
    )
    and (
      v_provider_key is null
      or not exists(
        select 1 from public.listings g
        where g.dedupe_group_id=l.dedupe_group_id and g.id<>c.id
          and g.is_active=true and g.quality_status<>'rejected'
          and app_private.provider_object_identity(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence) is not null
          and split_part(app_private.provider_object_identity(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence),'|',1)=split_part(v_provider_key,'|',1)
          and app_private.provider_object_identity(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence)<>v_provider_key
      )
    )
    and (
      v_saga_ref is null
      or not exists(
        select 1 from public.listings g
        where g.dedupe_group_id=l.dedupe_group_id and g.id<>c.id
          and g.is_active=true and g.quality_status<>'rejected'
          and app_private.saga_object_ref(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence) is not null
          and app_private.saga_object_ref(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence)<>v_saga_ref
      )
    )
    and (
      (v_provider_key is not null and app_private.provider_object_identity(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence)=v_provider_key)
      or (v_saga_ref is not null and app_private.saga_object_ref(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence)=v_saga_ref)
      or v_sid is null
      or not exists(
        select 1 from public.listings g
        cross join lateral(select app_private.immomio_application_target(g.raw,g.canonical_url) target) t
        where g.dedupe_group_id=l.dedupe_group_id and g.id<>c.id
          and g.is_active=true and g.quality_status<>'rejected'
          and t.target->>'status'='resolved' and t.target->>'source_identifier'<>v_sid
      )
    )
  order by
    (v_provider_key is not null and app_private.provider_object_identity(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence)=v_provider_key) desc,
    (v_saga_ref is not null and app_private.saga_object_ref(l.raw,l.enrichment_evidence)=v_saga_ref) desc,
    (l.dedupe_group_id=v_old_group) desc nulls last,
    l.first_seen_at,l.id
  limit 1;

  if v_group is null and v_old_group is not null
     and exists(select 1 from public.listing_dedupe_groups where id=v_old_group)
     and (
       v_provider_key is null
       or not exists(
         select 1 from public.listings g
         where g.dedupe_group_id=v_old_group and g.id<>c.id
           and g.is_active=true and g.quality_status<>'rejected'
           and app_private.provider_object_identity(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence) is not null
           and split_part(app_private.provider_object_identity(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence),'|',1)=split_part(v_provider_key,'|',1)
           and app_private.provider_object_identity(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence)<>v_provider_key
       )
     )
     and (
       v_saga_ref is null
       or not exists(
         select 1 from public.listings g
         where g.dedupe_group_id=v_old_group and g.id<>c.id
           and g.is_active=true and g.quality_status<>'rejected'
           and app_private.saga_object_ref(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence) is not null
           and app_private.saga_object_ref(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence)<>v_saga_ref
       )
     )
     and (
       (v_provider_key is not null and exists(
         select 1 from public.listings g
         where g.dedupe_group_id=v_old_group and g.id<>c.id
           and app_private.provider_object_identity(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence)=v_provider_key
       ))
       or (v_saga_ref is not null and exists(
         select 1 from public.listings g
         where g.dedupe_group_id=v_old_group and g.id<>c.id
           and app_private.saga_object_ref(g.raw,g.enrichment_evidence)=v_saga_ref
       ))
       or v_sid is null
       or not exists(
         select 1 from public.listings g
         cross join lateral(select app_private.immomio_application_target(g.raw,g.canonical_url) target)t
         where g.dedupe_group_id=v_old_group and g.id<>c.id
           and g.is_active=true and g.quality_status<>'rejected'
           and t.target->>'status'='resolved' and t.target->>'source_identifier'<>v_sid
       )
     )
  then
    v_group:=v_old_group;
  end if;

  if v_group is null then
    insert into public.listing_dedupe_groups default values returning id into v_group;
  end if;

  update public.listings set dedupe_group_id=v_group
  where id=c.id and dedupe_group_id is distinct from v_group;

  if v_old_group is not null and v_old_group<>v_group then
    perform app_private.refresh_listing_dedupe_group(v_old_group);
  end if;

  v_winner:=app_private.refresh_listing_dedupe_group(v_group);
  update public.listings
  set dedupe_match_reason=case when id=v_winner then 'primary' else 'duplicate' end
  where dedupe_group_id=v_group
    and dedupe_match_reason is distinct from (case when id=v_winner then 'primary' else 'duplicate' end);

  update public.delivery_events de
  set status='skipped',next_retry_at=null,error_message='Deduplicated in favor of preferred listing'
  from public.listings dl
  where de.listing_id=dl.id and dl.dedupe_group_id=v_group and dl.id<>v_winner
    and de.status in ('pending','failed') and not coalesce(de.delivery_outcome_unknown,false);

  return v_group;
end
$function$

routines.name: canonical_provider_entity
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.canonical_provider_entity(p_value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_value is null or btrim(p_value)='' then null
    when lower(p_value) ~ 'saga' then 'SAGA'
    when lower(p_value) ~ 'finkenw(ä|ae)rder.*hoffnung' then 'Finkenwärder-Hoffnung'
    when lower(p_value) ~ 'gewoba[[:space:]-]*nord' then 'GEWOBA Nord'
    when lower(p_value) ~ 'neue[[:space:]]+lübecker' then 'NEUE LÜBECKER'
    when lower(p_value) ~ 'reiherstieg' then 'Bauverein Reiherstieg'
    when lower(p_value) ~ 'vereinigte.*hamburger.*wohnungsbau|^vhw$' then 'VHW'
    when lower(p_value) ~ 'gartenstadt[[:space:]]+farmsen|^mgf' then 'mgf Gartenstadt Farmsen'
    when lower(p_value) ~ 'rahlstedter.*baugenossenschaft|^harabau$' then 'HARABAU'
    else btrim(p_value)
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.cleanup_expired_platform_auth_flows()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare removed integer;
begin
  with doomed as (
    select id from public.platform_auth_flows
    where expires_at < now() - interval '1 hour' or consumed_at < now() - interval '1 day'
    order by expires_at
    limit 500
  )
  delete from public.platform_auth_flows f using doomed d where f.id=d.id;
  get diagnostics removed = row_count;
  return removed;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.coaching_actor_can_access(p_actor uuid, p_user uuid, p_admin_required boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1
    from public.coaching_members m
    join public.coaching_workspaces w on w.id=m.workspace_id
    join public.coaching_participants cp on cp.workspace_id=m.workspace_id
    where m.id=p_actor
      and m.is_active
      and w.is_active
      and not w.operations_paused
      and cp.user_id=p_user
      and cp.status in ('active','archived','pending_deletion')
      and (m.role='admin' or (not p_admin_required and cp.coach_member_id=m.id))
  )
$function$
routines.identity_arguments: p_actor uuid, p_user uuid, p_admin_required boolean

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.platform_auth_flows set consumed_at=coalesce(consumed_at,clock_timestamp())
  where issued_by=new.auth_user_id and consumed_at is null;
  update app_private.telegram_link_tokens set invalidated_at=coalesce(invalidated_at,clock_timestamp())
  where created_by=new.auth_user_id and consumed_at is null and invalidated_at is null;
  return new;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.coaching_manager_assignment_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_member public.coaching_members%rowtype;
begin
  if new.coach_member_id is null then return new; end if;
  if tg_op='UPDATE'
     and new.coach_member_id is not distinct from old.coach_member_id
     and new.workspace_id is not distinct from old.workspace_id then
    return new;
  end if;
  select * into v_member
  from public.coaching_members
  where id=new.coach_member_id
    and workspace_id=new.workspace_id
    and role in ('coach','admin')
    and is_active
  for share;
  if not found then raise exception 'coach_unavailable'; end if;
  return new;
end
$function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.coaching_super_admin_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.is_super_admin
     and (new.role<>'admin' or not exists(
       select 1
       from app_private.coaching_super_admin_allowlist
       where auth_user_id=new.auth_user_id
     ))
  then
    raise exception 'super_admin_not_allowed';
  end if;

  if tg_op='UPDATE'
     and old.is_super_admin
     and (
       not new.is_super_admin
       or not new.is_active
       or new.auth_user_id is distinct from old.auth_user_id
     )
  then
    raise exception 'super_admin_protected';
  end if;

  return new;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.enqueue_due_source_jobs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 65)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  r record;
  v_msg_id bigint;
  v_job_id uuid;
  v_count integer := 0;
begin
  for r in
    select s.id
    from public.sources s
    where s.enabled = true
      and s.runtime_mode = 'live'
      and s.delivery_mode = 'live'
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.source_jobs j
        where j.source_id = s.id
          and j.status in ('enqueued','processing','retry')
          and j.queue_msg_id is not null
      )
      and (
        s.last_checked_at is null
        or s.last_checked_at <= now() - make_interval(
          mins => least(
            60,
            greatest(1, s.poll_interval_minutes) *
            case
              when coalesce(s.consecutive_failures,0) <= 1 then 1
              when s.consecutive_failures = 2 then 2
              when s.consecutive_failures = 3 then 4
              when s.consecutive_failures = 4 then 8
              else 12
            end
          )
        )
      )
    order by
      coalesce(s.crawl_priority,2147483647),
      coalesce(s.last_checked_at,'-infinity'::timestamptz),
      s.id
    limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,65),65))
    for update of s skip locked
  loop
    v_job_id := gen_random_uuid();

    select x into v_msg_id
    from pgmq.send(
      'source_jobs',
      jsonb_build_object(
        'job_id',v_job_id,
        'source_id',r.id,
        'worker','source-worker'
      )
    ) as x
    limit 1;

    insert into public.source_jobs(
      id,queue_msg_id,source_id,status,worker,enqueued_at,updated_at
    )
    values(
      v_job_id,v_msg_id,r.id,'enqueued','source-worker',now(),now()
    );

    update public.sources
    set last_checked_at=now(),updated_at=now()
    where id=r.id;

    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;

  return v_count;
end;
$function$

routines.name: enqueue_matched_application
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.enqueue_matched_application()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if coalesce(new.event_type,'new_listing') <> 'new_listing'
     or not app_private.delivery_newness_qualified(new.listing_id,statement_timestamp())
  then
    return new;
  end if;

  insert into public.applications(user_id,listing_id,source_id)
  select u.id,l.id,l.source_id
  from public.bot_users u
  join public.listings l on l.id=new.listing_id
  join public.sources s on s.id=l.source_id
  cross join lateral (
    select app_private.application_provider_target(l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url) as provider
  ) target
  where u.id=new.recipient_user_id
    and u.is_active
    and target.provider is not null
    and app_private.user_is_premium(u.id)
    and app_private.applicant_profile_identity_ready(u.id)
    and app_private.application_provider_preference_enabled(u.id,target.provider)
    and app_private.application_target_ready(u.id,l.source_id,l.raw,l.canonical_url)
    and app_private.application_listing_auto_apply_allowed(l.title,l.property_type,l.raw)
    and l.is_active
    and coalesce(l.quality_status,'unchecked')<>'rejected'
    and coalesce(l.is_primary_listing,false)
    and s.enabled
    and s.runtime_mode='live'
    and s.delivery_mode='live'
  on conflict(user_id,listing_id) do nothing;

  return new;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.enqueue_platform_reauth_notification()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status <> 'needs_login'
     or (tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.status is not distinct from 'needs_login')
  then
    if new.status = 'connected' and (tg_op = 'INSERT' or old.status is distinct from 'connected') then
      update public.platform_reauth_notifications
      set status='resolved', updated_at=now()
      where user_id=new.user_id and provider=new.provider
        and status in ('pending','sending','sent','failed');
    end if;
    return new;
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1 from public.bot_users u
    where u.id=new.user_id and u.is_active and u.auto_apply_enabled
      and public.application_user_eligible(u.id)
  )
  and app_private.application_provider_preference_enabled(new.user_id,new.provider)
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.platform_reauth_notifications n
    where n.user_id=new.user_id and n.provider=new.provider
      and n.status in ('pending','sending')
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.platform_reauth_notifications n
    where n.user_id=new.user_id and n.provider=new.provider
      and n.status='sent' and n.last_sent_at > now()-interval '24 hours'
  )
  then
    insert into public.platform_reauth_notifications(user_id,provider,reason)
    values (new.user_id,new.provider,coalesce(nullif(new.last_error,''),'needs_login'));
  end if;
  return new;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.guard_application_opt_in()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.auto_apply_enabled and (tg_op='INSERT' or not coalesce(old.auto_apply_enabled,false)) then
    if not new.is_active
       or not app_private.user_is_premium(new.id)
       or not app_private.applicant_profile_identity_ready(new.id)
       or not app_private.user_has_application_provider(new.id)
    then
      raise exception 'automatic applications are not available';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.invalidate_listing_ingest_fingerprint()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- An external writer/enricher may change source fields without computing a new hash.
  -- Force the next crawl through normal ingestion instead of trusting a stale hash.
  IF NEW.ingest_fingerprint IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.ingest_fingerprint THEN
    NEW.ingest_fingerprint := NULL;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

routines.name: invalidate_participant_tickets
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.invalidate_participant_tickets()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op='UPDATE'
     and (
       new.coach_member_id is distinct from old.coach_member_id
       or new.status is distinct from old.status
       or new.assignment_version is distinct from old.assignment_version
     )
  then
    update public.platform_auth_flows
    set consumed_at=coalesce(consumed_at,now())
    where user_id=new.user_id and consumed_at is null;

    update app_private.telegram_link_tokens
    set invalidated_at=coalesce(invalidated_at,now())
    where user_id=new.user_id
      and consumed_at is null
      and invalidated_at is null;
  end if;
  return new;
end
$function$
